desc: Derive an exact feasibility criterion for swapping two labeled pieces, including trees, bridges, bipartite graphs, and cyclic graphs.
Prove the minimum-operation formula, including any parity or detour terms.
Develop an \(O((N+M)\log N)\) min-cost flow algorithm using vertex splitting and two augmentations.
Validate the characterization on the provided samples and adversarial cases such as bridges and path graphs.
Write the final memory-safe Python stdin/stdout implementation.
